retrievalProfile.description: A maximalist, high-contrast digital collage featuring diamond-encrusted 3D lettering, luxury symbols like mansions and cars, and central figures flanked by guard dogs.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, layered composition characterized by 'bling' aesthetics, featuring a central figure in formal attire, large guard dogs in the foreground, and a background of opulent architecture under a bright sky, all unified by heavy airbrushing and sparkling diamond textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure framed by a classical rotunda and flanked by large dogs
Oversized 3D bejeweled typography arching over the top
Symmetrical placement of luxury cars and mansions in the mid-ground
High-contrast lighting with artificial lens flares and sparkles
coreInvariants: Diamond-pavé texture on primary display text
Heavy airbrushed glow around all subjects
Low-angle perspective emphasizing power and scale

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central human figure at medium-long shot, flanked by two large dogs in the immediate foreground occupying the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched 3D text at the top and the central figure's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top bejeweled text, moves down to the central figure, then outward to the dogs and background architecture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with detail, textures, and overlapping elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues and blacks in the clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and sky blue in the background architecture and sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and silver metallic glints, with cyan diamond sparkles.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues; high value contrast between the dark foreground figures and the bright, blown-out background.
paletteRestrictions: Focus on metallic and jewel-toned highlights

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, extra-bold sans-serif and slab-serif hybrids.
letterConstructionRules: Surfaces filled with repeating diamond/gemstone patterns
Inner glow and outer drop shadows for maximum separation
characterSpecificRedesigns: Arched baseline for the top display text
Condensed verticality for bottom subtitle text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact 3D bejeweled display text paired with a more legible but still stylized metallic subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the 3D extrusion effect.
Matches the sharp, authoritative feel of the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a maximalist digital collage featuring a man in a black suit and hat sitting in front of a white luxury car and a large mansion. Include two large, muscular dogs in the foreground. Use a bright, airbrushed 90s digital art style with lens flares and a blue sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, arched 3D text at the top with a blue diamond-encrusted texture and silver bevels. Add a gold-metallic condensed subtitle at the bottom with a black outer glow.

verificationChecks: Is the top text arched and bejeweled?
Are there large dogs in the foreground?
Is the lighting high-contrast with visible sparkles?
Does the background feature luxury architecture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the central figure
Any recognizable brand logos on the cars or clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text looks like physical 3D objects encrusted with gems.
Check that the dogs and human figure are integrated via airbrushed lighting.
Verify the background mansion has a 'dream-like' or surreal brightness.
Confirm the presence of 'bling' sparkles on metallic surfaces.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Luxury Subject] + [Guard Animals] + [Mansion/Estate Background] + [3D Diamond-Encrusted Arched Text] using a [90s Digital Airbrush] filter.
